Runtime camera: mode 1 snaps to the group midpoint at frame 0, then eases 10 % of the gap per frame capped at 3 px per frame (no zoom, no vertical follow); mode 2 advances min(speed, room) per frame and stops while any cat is dying; the right stop is mapW + autoScrollEndOffset * (party - 2) on auto-scroll stages (12-3: +300 at 4 cats, +900 at 8); clamped to >= 0. Planes (4-2, 12-3) move with the auto-scroll (speed + their own 3 per tick when held right, the scroll speed when idle).
